title: The appointment card
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies (the trilogy ran in print in three papers)
logline: Thursday. An appointment card on the corkboard: MON 24 · 9:00. Pinned beside the 1999 schedule and the 2010 program. The third folded thing. This one faces out.

panels.composition: The garage. WOOD pinning a small card to the corkboard. BARNABY in the bed under the low table.

image.prompt: quiet ink line with water bleeding over the edges, desaturated wet-on-wet in raw umber and Payne's gray and Prussian blue, a thin man pinning a small card to a crowded corkboard in a garage while an old dog lies in a bed beneath a lowered table

panels.composition: The card: COUNTY ANIMAL CLINIC · MON NOV 24 · 9:00 AM. Beside it the schedule and the program, both blank sides out. This one faces out.

image.prompt: quiet ink line with water bleeding over the edges, desaturated wet-on-wet in raw umber and Payne's gray and Prussian blue, close-up of a corkboard with two folded papers pinned blank side out and a small clinic appointment card pinned facing outward beside them
image.notes: Letter after: COUNTY ANIMAL CLINIC · MON NOV 24 · 9:00 AM. The only one of the three that faces out.

panels.composition: Wood stepping back. Looking at it. The dog lifting his head, looking at Wood looking at it.
